title: The Bridal Atelier Hero Banner
headline: Made by hand.
description: Hallmarked 22K harams, polki chokers and matched suites — eight to fourteen weeks on the bench, fitted three times before they leave.

title: Free Gold Testing Hero Banner
headline: Gold testing.
description: Bring in any gold, from anywhere. We will test its purity on the XRF while you watch, melt it or value it — at no charge, whether you bought it here or not.

title: IGI & GIA Certified Diamonds Hero Banner
headline: One stone,
description: We will put four diamonds on a tray at four price points, hand you a loupe, and explain honestly what separates them before anybody mentions money.

title: Three Generations Legacy Hero Banner
headline: Three generations.
description: The largest jewellery showroom in Kandivali — 1,350 sq ft, seventeen people, and a family that has weighed gold across a counter since before most of them were born.

title: Light Enough Daily Wear Hero Banner
headline: Light enough
description: Screwed backs, bezel settings and laser-welded links. Designed to survive a commute, a kitchen and a toddler — and still look like itself in ten years.
